entry.title: Wireless connectivity issues for Macs - November 4, 2026 - 13:00 PT
entry.content:
Nov 17, 13:16 MST
Resolved - This incident has been resolved.

Nov 12, 07:01 MST
Monitoring - After investigating, UBC IT technicians have determined that a recent required network upgrade resulted in some older devices being unable to connect to UBC's networks. UBC's wireless network remains fully functional, and most up-to-date devices are able to connect.

We strongly recommend that all clients ensure their devices are up to date with the latest versions of their operating system. For Macs this is MacOS 27.2.1, and for iPhone/iPad this is iOS version 27.2.1.

If your phone or computer is unable to update to the latest version, clients may opt to use the UBC IoT network as an alternative, if connecting from on-campus. More information about the IoT network can be found at https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi.

Nov 4, 16:38 MST
Update - Noted workarounds appear to be working for affected users.
Technicians are still monitoring the issue; however, recommendation is to apply one of the workarounds/fixes.

Nov 4, 14:53 MST
Update - Issue is still being investigated.

For workarounds:

1. Update your MacOS operating system
2. Use the UBCIoT Wifi network (https://it.ubc.ca/services/email-voice-internet/ubc-internet-things-iot-wi-fi)

Investigating - Faculty are unable to view their current or upcoming teaching assignments when using the View My Teaching Schedule report in Workday. The issue is being investigated.
